task: Add read-only admin dashboard and dashboard APIs
summary: Added a read-only local admin dashboard as an additive layer over the protected WhatsApp AI Agent backend. Added dashboard data queries, static dashboard assets, read-only APIs, root redirect, and integration coverage. Existing webhook, health, readiness, provider, booking, and SQLite behavior was preserved.
reason: The project request required a professional dashboard at /dashboard without replacing the existing API. The dashboard reuses the existing SQLite connection, reports real database values, masks WhatsApp identifiers, shows knowledge-file presence, and is disabled in production until admin authentication exists.
tests: npm test: 32 files and 164 tests passed. npm run typecheck passed. npm run lint passed. npm run build passed. Built-server verification: GET / returned 302 to /dashboard, GET /dashboard returned 200, dashboard summary returned real SQLite counts, /health and /readiness returned 200, invalid POST /webhook returned 401, and SIGINT shutdown completed cleanly. Docker build remains unverified because the Docker Desktop Linux daemon was unavailable.
nextSteps: Add authenticated production dashboard access before enabling the dashboard in production. Then add paginated customer, conversation, booking, logs, and knowledge detail views. Reconcile the existing unknown-owned working-tree edits before committing or merging.
attribution: Observed during this session; not proof of exclusive authorship.
